_comment: OPTIONAL and GATED — not enabled by default. firecrawl_search and single-URL firecrawl_scrape are allowed; crawl / map / extract / agent are blocked by mcp-write-gate.sh and require a scoped approval under .agent-runs/approvals/. FIRECRAWL_API_KEY is required for hosted/paid modes (subscription-first: enabling paid modes requires explicit user approval). Verify the launch command against current Firecrawl MCP docs.
